title: Workspaces, Apps and Distribution

header.html: Create and configure a workspace; Configure and update an app; Publish, import, or update items in a workspace; Create dashboards; Choose a distribution method; Configure subscriptions and data alerts; Promote content or apply the higher endorsement level that only authorized reviewers can set; Identify when a gateway is required; Configure a semantic model scheduled refresh
the official PL-300 study guide (skills measured as of April 20, 2026)

html:
1Workspaces and apps

A workspace is where a team builds and manages content. An app is how finished content reaches consumers.

Workspace topic Fact
Create In the service choose Workspaces, then New workspace; name it and pick a license mode
License mode Pro or PPU, or a Premium or Fabric capacity; on Premium or F64 and above, Viewers can use a free license
Roles Admin, Member, Contributor, Viewer, given to users or groups (Module 15)
Limits Up to 1,000 items in a workspace; a Pro user can be in up to 1,000 workspaces
My workspace Personal space; Direct Lake is not supported there
App topic Fact
How many One app per workspace
Audiences Up to 25 audiences; each sees only the content you choose
Audience options Allow sharing, allow building content, allow access to hidden content
Who publishes Admin and Member; a Contributor can update it only if an Admin allows
Licenses Creating or updating needs Pro or PPU; consumers need Pro or PPU unless the workspace is on Premium or F64 and above, where free users can view

To update an app, change the workspace content, then update the app. Consumers see the new version only after that.

Exam tip

. One workspace has one app, and one app can have many audiences. Two groups that need different reports from one workspace get one app with two audiences.

2Publish, import, update and dashboards

Way in How it works
Publish from Desktop On the Home tab choose Publish, then pick the workspace
Upload a .pbix In the workspace choose Upload and pick the file
Get data in the service Create a semantic model and report from files or databases online
Update Publishing again with the same name replaces the report and its semantic model

Contributor or higher can add and change items.

A dashboard is created in the service only, never in Desktop. It is one page of tiles pinned from reports, Excel, Q and A, images, text or video. Pin a whole report page to get a live page tile. Creating one needs edit permission, and Pro or PPU outside My workspace.

Feature Report Dashboard
Built in Desktop or service Service only
Pages One or more One page of tiles
Sources A semantic model Tiles from many reports and models
Slicers and filters Yes No
Data alerts No Yes, on tiles
Exam tip

. Dashboards exist only in the service, hold tiles from many reports, and have no slicers. If a question needs one page that mixes several models, think dashboard.

3Choose a distribution method

Need Method Recipients need
People build and edit together Workspace access A workspace role
Many consumers, curated content, groups App with audiences Pro or PPU, or a Premium or F64 workspace
One item for a person or group Share link Read by default; Pro or PPU unless the content is in Premium
Show a report inside another site or app Embed Access to the report; publishing to the web is public
A regular email of a page Subscription Pro or PPU, or content in Premium
A file copy of the data Export The export setting; Build for underlying data
Exam tip

. Workspace role for collaborators, app for broad consumers, share link for one item. If a scenario says "many readers, curated, different groups", the answer is the app.

4Subscriptions, data alerts and endorsement

Feature Email subscription Data alert
On A report or dashboard A dashboard tile from a card, gauge or KPI (numeric)
Limit Up to 24 per item Up to 250 alerts
Timing Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly or After data refresh Checked about hourly or daily
License Pro or PPU, or content in Premium Pro outside My workspace
Notes A full-report PDF or PowerPoint attachment needs Premium or PPU; subscribing others needs Contributor or higher Service only; only you see your alerts; works with Power Automate

To set an alert, open the tile's ellipsis, choose Manage alerts, then Add alert rule. Set the title, threshold, frequency and email.

Endorsement helps people find trusted content. It has two levels, and it does not change who has access.

Level Who can set it
Promoted The content owner, or a member with write permission
The higher level Only authorized reviewers that the Power BI admin chooses

It applies to semantic models, reports, apps and dataflows.

Exam tip

. Promoted can be set by the owner; the higher endorsement level only by authorized reviewers. A subscription sends a snapshot on a schedule; a data alert fires when a tile value crosses a threshold.

5Gateways and scheduled refresh

A gateway is Windows software that lets the service reach a source it cannot reach directly. It uses outbound connections only. It is needed for on-premises or private-network sources, for refresh, DirectQuery and live connection. Cloud sources need none.

Gateway Fact
Standard Shared and centrally managed; supports DirectQuery and live connection; can form clusters
Personal One user; Import refresh only; cannot be shared
VNet data gateway Microsoft-managed, nothing to install; for sources in a virtual network

Direct Lake cannot use a gateway.

Refresh setting Fact
Limit per day Pro up to 8; PPU, Premium and Fabric up to 48
Time zone Times follow the time zone set for the model
Credentials Set in the semantic model settings; only the owner changes them (others take over)
Gateway Map the model to one gateway connection; one gateway per model
Failures Email to the owner; the schedule is disabled after 4 consecutive failures
Other Daily quota resets at 12:01 AM; Refresh now is not counted
Exam tip

. Pro: up to 8 scheduled refreshes a day; Premium, PPU and Fabric: up to 48. Four consecutive failures disable the schedule.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A workspace holds six reports. The sales team must see two of them and the finance team must see four. What should an Admin do?

  • APublish two apps from the workspace, one for each team
  • BPublish one app with two audiences and assign the reports
  • CAdd both teams as Viewers and hide the other reports
  • DShare each report with the right team one report at a time
Show the answer

Answer: B. A workspace has one app, and audiences control which content each group sees.

S2An Import semantic model sits in a Pro workspace and must refresh every 30 minutes all day. Which change meets the need?

  • AMove the workspace to a PPU, Premium or Fabric capacity
  • BTurn on automatic page refresh in the report settings
  • CAdd a standard gateway connection to the semantic model
  • DSet the schedule to use a different time zone daily
Show the answer

Answer: A. Pro allows up to 8 scheduled refreshes a day, while PPU, Premium and Fabric allow up to 48.

S3A report uses DirectQuery against a SQL Server database in the company's data center. Users open it in the service. What is required?

  • AA personal mode gateway installed by the author
  • BA VNet data gateway created for the workspace
  • CA standard mode gateway with a data source connection
  • DNo gateway, because DirectQuery does not import any data
Show the answer

Answer: C. An on-premises DirectQuery source needs a standard gateway, since a personal gateway supports Import refresh only.

S4A manager wants an email whenever the daily revenue number on a dashboard falls below a target. What should the manager set up?

  • AA data alert on a tile pinned from a card visual
  • BAn email subscription with the Hourly frequency
  • CA data alert on a tile pinned from a matrix
  • DA bookmark on the report page with a filter
Show the answer

Answer: A. Data alerts work on numeric tiles from cards, gauges and KPIs and email when a threshold is crossed; a subscription sends a snapshot regardless of the value.

S5The owner of a semantic model wants colleagues to see it as recommended content in search. Which action can the owner take?

  • AApply the higher endorsement level to the model
  • BApply a sensitivity label to the model
  • CApply the Promoted endorsement to the model
  • DGive every colleague the Build permission
Show the answer

Answer: C. An owner can promote content, while the higher level is set only by authorized reviewers and a sensitivity label does not endorse.

S6A team in a Pro-only workspace wants a weekly email subscription that attaches the full report as a PDF. What is required?

  • AA Contributor role for every subscriber in the workspace
  • BThe report moved to a workspace on Premium or PPU
  • CThe Build permission on the report's semantic model
  • DA standard gateway with a data source connection
Show the answer

Answer: B. A full-report attachment needs Premium or PPU, which a Pro-only workspace does not provide.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How many apps can one workspace have?

Show the answer

One, with up to 25 audiences.

R2Where can you create a dashboard?

Show the answer

In the Power BI service only.

R3How many scheduled refreshes a day does Pro allow?

Show the answer

Up to 8 (PPU, Premium and Fabric: up to 48).

R4After how many consecutive failures is a scheduled refresh disabled?

Show the answer

Four.

R5Which gateway mode supports Import refresh only?

Show the answer

Personal mode.

R6What happens when you publish a .pbix with the same name to the same workspace?

Show the answer

The existing report and semantic model are replaced.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Workspace license mode; roles Admin, Member, Contributor, Viewer; up to 1,000 items; Direct Lake not in My workspace
App one per workspace; up to 25 audiences; Admin and Member publish; Pro or PPU unless Premium or F64 and above
Publish Desktop publish, upload a .pbix, Get data in the service; same name replaces
Dashboard service only; one page of tiles; no slicers; pin a page for a live tile
Distribution role for collaborators; app for consumers; share link for one item; embed; subscription; export
Subscription and alert up to 24 subscriptions per item; up to 250 data alerts on card, gauge or KPI tiles
Endorsement Promoted by the owner; the higher level only by authorized reviewers
Gateway needed for on-premises and private-network sources; standard, personal (Import only), VNet; none for cloud; Direct Lake none
Scheduled refresh Pro 8 a day, others 48; owner sets credentials; disabled after 4 failures
